title: Compatibility rule
description: States what a detected plugin, theme or stack component depends on. The CompatibilityResolver turns these into dependencies_detected counts and dont_touch decisions; a compatibility rule never names a tweak.

subject.description: What the rule is about: plugin:<slug>, theme:<slug>, or host:<vendor>.

requires.description: Capabilities the subject depends on. The vocabulary is closed so the resolver can reason about it.

notes.description: Why the dependency exists, shown as evidence when this rule causes a dont_touch.

confidence.description: How sure we are of the dependency. Feeds ConfidenceCalculator.
